subject: MAP: CentraPay onramp — security acceptance & retention playbook
messages:
From: Evan Allen <evan.allen@centrapay.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.inference>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@centrapay.com>, Jamie Liu <j.liu@centrapay.com>
Date: 2028-07-01T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: CentraPay MAP & security acceptance checklist

Hi Mina —

Thanks for the inbound conversation this week. As discussed on the call, CentraPay would like to put a short Mutual Action Plan together so we can get Redwood into production for our payments reconciliation workflows. High level asks from our side:

- SOC 2 Type II report (most recent) and evidence of remediation items (if applicable)
- Completed SIG/CAIQ matrix or equivalent security questionnaire
- DPA with standard and a couple of carveouts (we will send our redline)
- Clarify data residency and retention options (logs vs transaction records) and KMS/HSM posture
- A target acceptance date (we are aiming for a go-live window of the week of July 20)

Can you confirm who on the Redwood side will own each lane (security evidence, DPA negotiation, infra/residency)? We'll kick off procurement in parallel — I'll attach a one-page intake with the pieces we need.

I've attached: CentraPay_SIG_CAICQ_Request.xlsx (questionnaire), and a procurement intake PDF.

Thanks — looking to move quickly here.

—Evan
Evan Allen
Head of Platform Security, CentraPay Inc

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.inference>
To: Evan Allen <evan.allen@centrapay.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.inference, jordan_blake@redwood.inference, jonas_weber@redwood.inference
Date: 2028-07-01T18:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CentraPay MAP & security acceptance checklist

Evan — thanks, good to meet you. We're aligned to run a short MAP for this onramp. Proposed plan & owners below:

- Security evidence & SIG/CAIQ: Jonas Weber (security onboarding lead) — will return a completed CAIQ and a short evidence pack (SOC2 stub + key artifacts)
- DPA & legal: Kimberly Park (counsel) — will review your redline and provide Redwood's standard DPA with any proposed carveouts
- Infra/residency & KMS: Jordan Blake (infra PM) — to confirm region options and KMS/HSM details
- Overall MAP owner / timeline owner: me (Mina) — I'll run cadence and weekly status

Tentative timeline:
- July 2: Redwood provides SOC2 stub and CAIQ draft
- July 6: weekly standup begins
- July 13: mutual acceptance on security artifacts and DPA initial alignment
- Target acceptance / go-live: July 20 (we should keep this flexible by a few days if procurement needs a signature window)

Action items for CentraPay: please confirm any non-standard retention windows (logs vs transactions) and add any mandatory clauses to your DPA redline so Kimberly can target review. We'll respond to the SIG/CAIQ within 48 hours after Jonas picks it up.

I'll attach a short MAP template (we'll use this to track owners / dates).

Thanks — Mina
Mina Haddad
Head of Customer Onboarding, Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood_MAP_Template_01.docx

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.inference>
To: Evan Allen <evan.allen@centrapay.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.inference>
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.inference, jonas_weber@redwood.inference
Date: 2028-07-02T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: RE: CentraPay MAP & security acceptance checklist — DPA redline

Evan / Mina — I've reviewed the incoming intake and prepared a first-pass redline of our standard DPA. High-level notes:

- Data retention: Redwood's default model is 365 days for customer data (configurable), 90 days for system logs. We can accommodate a longer retention for transaction records with agreed SLAs and potential cost adjustments.
- Residency: We offer US and EU region options; if CentraPay requires EU-only residency we will need a scoped deployment plan and SOC2 evidence for the region-specific infra (Jordan will advise).
- Subprocessors & KMS: Redwood uses managed KMS with customer-managed keys available on dedicated/private plans; HSM-backed KMS is available for enterprise agreements.
- Escrow / escrow-like commitments: we do not do full-code escrow for hosted deployments but can discuss snapshot/export commitments for data portability.

I've attached DPA_Redline_Centrapay_v1.docx with inline comments. Please highlight any absolutely non-negotiable clauses (e.g., mandatory 7-year archival for all records).

If CentraPay needs an accelerated review, we can slot a 30-min call with legal tomorrow morning.

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Attachment: DPA_Redline_Centrapay_v1.docx

From: Evan Allen <evan.allen@centrapay.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.inference>
Cc: Jamie Liu <j.liu@centrapay.com>, Procurement <procurement@centrapay.com>, kimberly_park@redwood.inference
Date: 2028-07-03T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CentraPay MAP & security acceptance checklist — confirmation and PO

Thanks team — appreciate the quick turnaround. A few clarifications from our side:

- Retention windows: CentraPay requires 180 days for operational logs and 7 years for transaction records (regulatory requirement). We understand this may be an outlier — please flag cost/technical implications.
- KMS/HSM: we prefer customer-controlled keys (bring-your-own key) for production. Can Jordan confirm availability on the dedicated lane and any lead time?
- Escrow: not mandatory for us if we get an explicit export/portability commitment plus a runbook for data handoff.

I've attached a procurement PO stub (CentraPay_PO_20280703.pdf) to align timelines — procurement will expect a signature window in the week of July 13-17. We'll plan weekly 30-min standups starting July 6 (Tue 9:30 PT).

Can we target delivering the completed SIG/CAIQ and SOC2 stub by end of day July 2 as Mina suggested? That will allow Kimberly to push the DPA review and hit July 13 alignment.

Appreciate it — Evan
Evan Allen
Head of Platform Security, CentraPay Inc
